name: SR-022
summary: Read the changed skill text; I ran no live session, which matches the proof type (an independent read). skills/application-materials/SKILL.md step 5 says: 'For every cover letter, always ask why this company, other motivations and what the owner wants to put forward, and wait for answers before drafting'. references/drafting-workflow.md line 53 gives the details. For every requested letter it asks the three questions before drafting, even when the evidence looks sufficient. It says 'Wait for the answers; there is no skip path, so never draft the letter without them' (EX-1). It shows an answer already recorded for the same company and asks only for confirmation or additions (EX-2). 'A no-letter employer instruction removes the letter deliverable and these questions' (EX-3). The same text is in the .agents, .claude and src/cv_toolkit/assets copies. One minor point: the review skills still say 'respect explicit declines' and 'unknown motivation permits neutral wording'. They cover the case where the owner has already answered unknown or declined, not a way to skip asking, so they don't contradict the requirement.
